messages.schedule.archive.confirm: Archive this scheduled task? It will no longer run automatically, and what it may read is revoked with it.
messages.schedule.directory.summary: Schedule conversations and receive plugin reminders on time.
messages.schedule.error.archive: Could not archive the scheduled task
messages.schedule.error.create: Could not create the scheduled task
messages.schedule.error.restore-operation: Could not restore the scheduled operation
messages.schedule.error.save: Could not save the scheduled task
messages.schedule.error.update: Could not update the scheduled job
messages.schedule.form.help: When due, it runs a turn in this task’s own chat, not an existing Coding session.
messages.schedule.form.instructions-hint: Read-only by default. Writes still go through the existing review queue.
messages.schedule.form.instructions-placeholder: At the due time the agent reads this and replies in this chat.
messages.schedule.form.notify: Mark the list when an update is important
messages.schedule.form.reads: Once it’s created, choose here what it may read. Without a choice it reads project files only.
messages.schedule.form.time-hint: Uses this computer’s local time. The alarm only fires while the local service is running.
messages.schedule.form.title: Title
messages.schedule.hint.model: No text model is configured, so the agent can’t run when the task is due. You can still create it and set one up later.
messages.schedule.hint.workspace: This project has no workspace bound, so the read-only agent can’t start when the task is due. You can still create it and bind a workspace later.
messages.schedule.job.identity-unverified: The original installation cannot be verified. Review the reminder and the current plugin before restoring it.
messages.schedule.job.install-first: Install and enable the corresponding plugin, then refresh to review it.
messages.schedule.list.empty-body: Create one and a read-only agent will run in that task’s own chat when it is due. Alarms registered by other plugins also appear here.
messages.schedule.operation.changed: The task has changed. Return to the list and choose again.
messages.schedule.operation.gone: The original alarm or operation is missing. Keep the history and create a new schedule.
messages.schedule.operation.warning-resume: Assign the original operation and input to the current installation. Undispatched work waits for a fresh wakeup, then keeps the original interval. This confirmation allows plugin code to run.
messages.schedule.operation.warning-retry: The previous call may already have incurred costs or made external changes. Retrying runs the same input again and may duplicate those effects. Check the external records first.
messages.schedule.operation.warning-skip: Skip the earliest unknown occurrence without running it again. Review any remaining unknown outcomes. Then continue at the original interval; a one-time task ends here.
messages.schedule.reads.created: Task created. Choose what it may read and the next run can read it.
messages.schedule.reads.failed: Can’t show what this task may read right now
messages.schedule.reads.failed-body: Permissions can’t be read right now. You can retry reading them. The task checks again when due; if it still can’t read them, that run fails.
messages.schedule.reads.needs-confirmation: One kind can read more, or reads differently now. It can’t be read until you confirm it again.
messages.schedule.reads.none: None chosen; reads project files only
messages.schedule.reads.nothing-readable: None of the chosen kinds can be read right now. It still runs when due and says what it couldn’t read.
messages.schedule.reads.removed: One kind is no longer offered, so this task can’t read it.
messages.schedule.reads.title: Data it can read
messages.schedule.reads.unavailable: One kind’s plugin is turned off, so it can’t be read for now. The permission stays and comes back with the plugin.
messages.schedule.reads.workspace: A task that reads only project files needs a workspace for this project first.
messages.schedule.recovery.gone: This reminder has been restored or no longer exists. Return to the list to check.
messages.schedule.recovery.note: Keep the original schedule. An overdue reminder is delivered once, then repeats at the original interval. This does not run plugin code.
messages.schedule.recovery.title: Restore this reminder
messages.schedule.agent-role.reader.name: Read-only runner
messages.schedule.agent-role.brief.name: Read data and run
messages.schedule.read-group.operations.descripti: This project’s scheduled tasks and reminders, and other plugins’ scheduled operations with their original input
messages.schedule.read-group.operations.title: Scheduled operations
messages.schedule.read-group.reminders.descriptio: This project’s reminders: what they say (including the text of reminders other plugins set), which plugin set them and when they are next due
messages.schedule.read-group.reminders.title: Reminders
